elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L01-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying knowledge of text structures such as introduction and topic sentences to predict key messages and recognise repeated discourse markers

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L01-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: interpreting non-verbal and evaluative language to deduce a speaker’s mood and/or feelings about a particular topic

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L02 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: extract key information or ideas from a variety of spoken texts across the curriculum, with minimal contextual support

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L02-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: accessing and comprehending a range of cross-curricular and multimodal texts such as a guest speaker’s talk, a short film and a podcast (with captions if needed)

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L02-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: taking notes from short talks and mini-lectures with reduced support; for example, using broad headings rather than topic-specific questions

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L02-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: listing arguments of a speaker, identifying the tone

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L03 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: participate effectively in exchanges and conversations with fluent speakers that involve changes of topic and register in the full range of classroom situations across the curriculum

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L03-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: participating in a range of classroom exchanges, including pair and group work and class discussions

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L03-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: initiating classroom exchanges for a range of purposes; for example, making statements, giving instructions, asking questions, articulating opinions, offering a suggestion and/or justification, or engaging in analysis, evaluation and/or critique

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L03-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: negotiating with peers or teachers in a wide range of situations, for example when planning work or brainstorming ideas

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L03-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: contributing to conversations with a range of people such as peers, teachers and visitors about a variety of topics, for example in discussions about family or future career

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L03-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: shifting register; for example, changing from talking about a classroom topic to making a request

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L04 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: prepare and deliver an extended formal presentation that reflects a clear progression of ideas relevant to the audience, context and purpose

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L04-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using organisational features of texts, including multimodal texts, to structure and connect complex ideas logically; for example, using topic sentences or preview and review

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L04-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: developing an appropriate style of speech for a purpose such as to inform, persuade or entertain

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L04-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: planning and rehearsing to enhance structure, content, language and presentation style

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L04-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: constructing a piece of text, such as a persuasive text, that flows logically and cohesively, has been researched and includes well-supported arguments using sophisticated vocabulary

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L04-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: speaking confidently using oral presentation skills, for example by making eye contact and using appropriate gestures, tone, register and intonation

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L05 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: sustain complex ideas and information in coherent spoken texts, taking account of audience, context and purpose

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L05-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding and applying organisational features of a range of spoken texts, from informal discussions to formal spoken and multimodal presentations; for example, using appropriate structure and well-sustained arguments supported by factual details

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L05-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: presenting a logical sequence of information in prepared and impromptu spoken texts

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L06 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: produce extended speech using a range of cohesive devices and signal words to connect ideas

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L06-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: extending and elaborating in spoken texts by giving details such as cause, contrast and evidence

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L06-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a range of connectives (such as those related to time, sequence, result, contrast and addition) to indicate relationships, for example ‘unless’, ‘in that case’, ‘however’ and ‘this shows …’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L06-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: connecting multiple clauses using a range of coordinating and subordinating conjunctions, for example in ‘Because of the flooding, they could not access their house and had to evacuate to the school instead.’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L06-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using pronoun references to maintain cohesion throughout an extended speech

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L06-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using appropriate metalanguage, for example in displays and explanations

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L07 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: formulate extended topic-related verb groups with increasing control over grammatical features

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L07-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: choosing from a wide range of action, saying, sensing and relating verbs such as ‘construct’, ‘produce’, ‘appreciate’ and ‘prefer’ to express precise meaning

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L07-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using extended verb groups, for example in ‘about to start packing up’ and ‘would not want to be noticed’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L07-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: expressing more complex verbs using elaborated tenses, for example in ‘hadn’t noticed’ and ‘we’re getting hungry’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L07-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: expressing modality through words such as ‘may’ and ‘might’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L07-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a range of expressions to structure a point of view, including conjunctions (such as ‘because’ and ‘so’), subjective language (such as ‘I believe that …’) and objective language (such as ‘Evidence shows that …’), and rebutting or clarifying an argument, for example ‘No, I mean that there should be an extra tax on soft drinks.’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L07-E06 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using nominalisation to make a spoken text more sophisticated, such as in reference to globalisation, sustainability or sustenance

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L08 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: use a range of extended descriptive phrases

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L08-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: expanding the detail in statements by using a range of grammatical features including adverbs, noun groups and more complex verb phrases, for example in ‘I eventually finished reading that very interesting and sometimes challenging book.’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L08-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: building noun groups using a range of adverbs, prepositional phrases and relative clauses, for example in ‘the unusual colours of the bird’s tail feathers, which help it camouflage in the grass’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L08-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: choosing appropriate vocabulary to construct noun groups for imaginative or informative texts, for example ‘a flock of colourful parrots’ and ‘less than 10 per cent of native seed-eating birds’

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L09 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: use words with multiple meanings across curriculum areas

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L09-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: experimenting with a range of vocabulary learnt from different curriculum areas in spoken texts such as discussions and presentations

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L09-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using different technical and everyday meanings of words; for example, using ‘state’ in reference to a territory, a state of matter and a state of affairs

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L09-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using familiar root words, prefixes and suffixes to make predictions about the meanings of unfamiliar words in a specific curriculum area

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L09-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: including idiomatic and colloquial language appropriately and spontaneously in discussions

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L10 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: use pronunciation and word stress accurately

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L10-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying different accents according to sociocultural or geographical background

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L10-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: experimenting with different ways of pronouncing the same sounds for effect

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L11 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: apply sentence stress, intonation and paralinguistic (non-verbal) features purposefully

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L11-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: modelling intonation, volume, stress and pacing on the speech of others such as teachers, peers, performers and presenters

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L11-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: adjusting features of speech to support and convey meaning; for example, modifying mood in storytelling or giving emphasis in persuasive speech

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L11-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using intonation, volume and stress to emphasise an opinion or emotion, for example ‘That is NOT what happened.’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L11-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a range of paralinguistic (non-verbal) features to enhance communication; for example, making eye contact and using facial expressions, gestures and posture

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L12 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: analyse and evaluate similarities and differences in spoken language use across cultures

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L12-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: sharing observations about and identifying similarities and differences in ways of communicating meaning in a home language and English; for example, discussing text structure, grammar, idioms and culturally specific ways of communicating

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L12-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising shifts between formal and informal registers in response to purpose and context

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L12-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying the appropriate register by matching elements of body language, voice, expression and use of personal or impersonal language

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L12-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying the adaptations needed for spoken language in common classroom interactions so it is appropriate to a particular context, purpose and audience

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L12-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: asking questions about points of pronunciation and grammar, for example ‘Why is it “the car door” and not “the car’s door”?’

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L13 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: employ a range of strategies to enhance comprehension and production of spoken English

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L13-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying patterns of pronunciation that pose difficulty in their own speech; for example, noting the articulation of final consonants or a specific vowel sound, or inappropriate word stress

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L13-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: rehearsing pronunciation with a partner or recording pronunciation using a digital device for self-assessment, in order to make improvements

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L13-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a range of strategies to clarify their own meaning; for example, recasting, defining and using a range of synonyms

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L13-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: collaborating with home language peers to clarify new vocabulary and ideas and to formulate home language terms and definitions

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L13-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: referring to a home language or bilingual glossaries, dictionaries, thesauruses or translation apps for explanation and clarification of new vocabulary and information

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L13-E06 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: recording words and information in a personal dictionary or notes, using a combination of English and a home language, to indicate meaning, pronunciation and usage

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L14 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: draw on an extensive and varied range of home language resources when listening and speaking

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L14-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: inferring the meaning and translation of unfamiliar words, based on context and previous learning in a home language

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L14-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: making their own translations of specific words and phrases

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L14-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using an accessible English dictionary or bilingual dictionary to check the meanings of unfamiliar words

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L14-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: crosschecking meaning in English and a home language to confirm accurate understanding of key concepts and vocabulary

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L14-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: contributing vocabulary found using dictionaries to classroom vocabulary lists referring to home language or bilingual texts such as glossaries, dictionaries or translation apps for explanation and clarification of new vocabulary and information

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4L15 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: initiate and manage collaborative group work

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L15-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: initiating and contributing to group work, for example by articulating goals, negotiating roles, explaining ideas and taking action

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L15-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: engaging other group members in interacting and contributing to group tasks

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4L15-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: drafting ideas and key points for discussion and/or taking notes in a home language

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R01 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: identify, analyse and evaluate the main ideas in a range of complex and unfamiliar texts

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R01-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: summarising the nature and content of a text, including making evaluative comments in a range of forms, for example by using notes and visual texts

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R01-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and analysing the supporting ideas and evidence in a persuasive text to determine whether the main idea is justified

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R02 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: extract and evaluate relevant information in a range of texts

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R02-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying the role of specific linguistic features and structures and evaluating their influence on meaning, for example for the role of extended metaphors such as in the short text Animal Farm

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R03 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: interpret and evaluate visual representations in a range of texts

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R03-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding connections between print and visual aspects of a text

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R03-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: navigating texts using features such as contents pages, indexes, hyperlinks and navigation menus

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R03-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: locating, interpreting and explaining information from visual representations such as tables, graphs, images, diagrams and maps

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R04 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: interpret a text at literal and inferential levels

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R04-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: evaluating aspects of language and content that affect the relevance, reliability or accessibility of a text

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R04-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: inferring the meaning of an unfamiliar word or phrase by using contextual information such as the topic of a text, meaning of adjacent sentences and meanings of familiar words in the same sentence

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R04-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: making connections between a text and their own experience or other texts to draw inferences and make predictions

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R04-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: assessing the range of perspectives present in text, in order to draw a conclusion

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R04-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: inferring the opinion of the writer, based on the ideas and cultural understandings in a text

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R05 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: examine the role of the structures and features of texts from different curriculum areas

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R05-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing and explaining the functions of features of texts, for example for an informative text and a persuasive text on the same topic

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R05-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing and contrasting text structures and language features of texts from different curriculum areas (e.g. comparing reports from Science and History or essays from English and Art) through guided activities such as labelling and sequencing

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R05-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: transforming texts from one type to another using appropriate features; for example, transforming an interview transcript into a report

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R06 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: understand complex text connections used to link ideas across sentences and paragraphs

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R06-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying connectives used to link ideas across a text, such as ‘nevertheless’ and ‘although’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R06-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: adding a range of conjunctions and connectives to a text to improve cohesion

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R06-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: sequencing parts of sentences into a longer cohesive text, using text connectives appropriately

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R06-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: tracking reference items across a complex text to follow ideas, for example by using pronouns, demonstratives and the definite article

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R07 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: understand complex language

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R07-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding sentences containing complex features such as embedded clauses, noun groups and modality, such as ‘If the temperature rises, the polar caps may melt, resulting in …’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R07-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: connecting and transforming simple sentences using a range of grammatical structures to create extended compound and complex sentences

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R08 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: understand a range of verb forms in particular text types

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R08-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding complex verb groups, including elaborated tenses (such as in ‘had not realised’), extended verb groups (such as in ‘did not expect to be found’) and modality (such as in ‘need to consider’)

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R08-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising verb forms that are used in particular text types; for example, noting the passive voice in procedural recounts

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R09 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: read and understand complex descriptive language

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R09-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding extended noun groups that use adverbs, prepositional phrases and relative clauses, such as in ‘the many ways in which groups of monkeys communicate through sound’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R09-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: extending simple descriptive sentences to make more complex sentences; for example, changing ‘The sprinkler was refreshing.’ to ‘The cool water from the sprinkler sprayed our scorched faces.’

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R10 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: recognise and use a wide range of words, including unusual and technical words and phrases, with accuracy

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R10-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: recognising some key word origins, including Greek roots, for example for the origins of the words ‘athlete’, ‘pentathlon’ and ‘decathlon’ in the Greek root ‘ath’ (meaning ‘contest’ or ‘outstanding skill’), ‘pent’ (referring to the number 5) and ‘dec’ (referring to the number 10)

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R10-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: expanding knowledge of prefixes and suffixes, and exploring how the meaning changes in words such as ‘dis + appearance’, ‘sub + marine’, ‘sub + terranean’, ‘poison + ous’ and ‘nerv + ous’

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R11 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: recognise and use a wide range of spelling conventions

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R11-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: applying accumulated knowledge of a wide range of letter patterns and spelling generalisations to spell unfamiliar words such as ‘ratio’ and ‘synthesis’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R11-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: explaining spelling generalisations; for example, knowing how the following words are spelt, and why: ‘reliability’, ‘handkerchief’, ‘receive’, ‘lollies’, ‘trolleys’, ‘climbing’, ‘designed’ and ‘emergency’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R11-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: spelling technical words such as ‘metaphorical’, ‘biology’ and ‘biodegradable’ by applying morphemic knowledge

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R11-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: understanding how to use spelling rules, base words, suffixes, prefixes, spelling patterns and word origins (including Greek and Latin roots) to learn how to spell unfamiliar words

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R12 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: understand most symbols and changes of font style and how they contribute to or change the meanings in a text

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R12-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying changes in font style (such as italic and bold) and recognising symbols or icons, explaining their function, for example that bold words have greater emphasis, … (ellipsis) means words are missing and a smiley face emoji means ‘happy’

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R13 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: analyse and evaluate specific characteristics and features of English texts in relation to home language(s)

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R13-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing features of texts in English and a home language, such as text structure, use of evidence, levels of formality and vocabulary choices

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R13-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing the structure and language of texts for different audiences or purposes related to the same topic across languages, such as a car advertisement and a road safety pamphlet

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R13-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: analysing and interpreting the differences in language choices and organisation of particular text types in relation to their purpose, audience and context

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R13-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying words and idioms for which there is no direct translation, and discussing the reasons for this

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R13-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing the connotations of key words in English and a home language, referring to a dictionary or thesaurus in each language

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R13-E06 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and explaining different points of view that are represented in texts, and suggesting perspectives that are missing

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R14 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: read a wide range of long complex print and digital texts independently

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R14-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: selecting a variety of print and digital texts to read independently

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R14-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: reading on their own for a variety of purposes; for example, reading a narrative text for enjoyment, analysing an argument in a persuasive text and evaluating content in an information text

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R14-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: locating information on a research topic using library resources and online materials, including appropriate search engines

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R14-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a bilingual dictionary, thesaurus or online tool to search for synonyms and antonyms for a known word in one language

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R14-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: crosschecking meaning in a home language and English to confirm accurate choice of vocabulary

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R14-E06 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: contributing vocabulary found using dictionaries and other resources to classroom vocabulary lists

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R14-E07 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: recording and organising ideas while reading, for example by using annotations, mind maps and tables

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R15 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: draw on an extensive and varied range of home language resources when reading and viewing

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R15-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: inferring the meaning and translation of unfamiliar words based on context and previous learning in a home language

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R15-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: making their own translations of specific words and phrases

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R15-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using an accessible English dictionary and/or bilingual dictionary to check the meanings of unfamiliar words

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R15-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: crosschecking meaning in English and a home language to confirm accurate understanding of key concepts and vocabulary

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R15-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: contributing vocabulary found using dictionaries to classroom vocabulary lists

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R15-E06 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: referring to a home language or bilingual texts such as glossaries, dictionaries and translation apps for explanation and clarification of new vocabulary and information

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4R16 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: contribute to and lead shared reading activities, including eliciting and communicating personal responses

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R16-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: reading a range of texts with diverse issues and perspectives, and sharing their personal views with peers

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R16-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying and responding to a range of cultural and literary representations, perspectives and stereotypes in texts

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R16-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: comparing or contrasting views represented in texts with different cultural values, including personal experiences, and sharing with peers

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R16-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: responding to imaginative texts, showing a sound understanding of key events, characters and issues

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R16-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: interpreting the feelings of a character at different points in a text and discussing views with a small group of peers

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R16-E06 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: forming conclusions and personal opinions about a text and comparing to the views of others

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4R16-E07 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: contributing to a book club or discussion group on a specific text

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W01 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: write an extended argument or discussion on a specific issue

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W01-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing a range of texts that present and justify a point of view, such as arguments, discussions and debates

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W01-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: building cohesive arguments, for example by showing supporting evidence, development of ideas and rebuttal

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W01-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a wide range of objective language to express points of view indirectly, for example ‘Evidence shows that …’ and ‘The film clearly indicated that …’

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W02 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: write extended information texts conveying a variety of aspects of topics from across the curriculum

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W02-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing a range of texts used across the curriculum, such as historical essays, reports, procedures, recounts and explanations, with reference to templates and models

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W02-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing extended information texts reflecting the structure and language of the text type

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W02-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: incorporating information from 2 or 3 sources used in the classroom into their own writing

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W03 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: write extended imaginative texts showing an awareness of audience and purpose, with teacher prompts

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W03-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: expressing personal opinions and creative ideas through a range of text types; for example, writing a personal diary, a response to a set text and contributions to an online discussion

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W03-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: adopting the structure and language used in templates and model imaginative texts, experimenting with new forms in some parts

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W04 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: incorporate visual features into extended texts

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W04-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: producing texts in a range of digital formats; for example, using slides, infographics, simple websites and videos

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W04-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: creating or adapting a range of visual features such as illustrations, diagrams, graphs, tables and maps

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W04-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: referring to images in text, for example ‘In Figure 1 …’ and ‘The image shows …’

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W05 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: write a range of extended texts using a structure appropriate to each text type

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W05-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: constructing a range of clearly structured and cohesive texts from different curriculum areas, such as reports, arguments, discussions and reviews

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W05-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using model texts and templates to inform the structure of print texts, making some adaptations to suit the particular purpose, audience and content of each text

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W06 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: write a range of cohesive texts with accuracy

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W06-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: connecting ideas at the whole-text level using organisational features; for example, writing a detailed introduction containing a preview of key ideas and a conclusion containing a clear summary

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W06-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing cohesive paragraphs with logical connections between ideas in each sentence

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W06-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using connectives to show contrast (such as ‘however’, ‘nevertheless’ and ‘although’), sequence (such as ‘finally’ and ‘subsequently’), addition (such as ‘additionally’ and ‘furthermore’) and consequence (such as ‘therefore’ and ‘consequently’)

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W06-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using pronouns to refer to repeated ideas in a section of text, for example in ‘The first reason … It is … This leads to …’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W06-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using complex prepositions to show relationships between ideas, for example in ‘Among the causes …’ and ‘After the protests …’

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W07 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: combine simple sentences into complex sentences using embedding structures

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W07-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: varying sentence structures to support the purpose of a text and create interest for a reader; for example, including rhetorical questions in an argument and varying sentence length within a paragraph

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W07-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using embedded clauses to create complex sentences, for example ‘The Prime Minister, having lost the support of her party, began to look for new allies among her former rivals.’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W07-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: constructing complex sentences using sophisticated relative clauses, for example ‘This film, which was adapted from the novel of the same name, raises some challenging issues.’

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W08 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: control a wide range of verb forms

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W08-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: controlling a wide range of tenses

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W08-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: attempting to write complex verb groups incorporating several elements such as time and negatives, for example in ‘I guess you are not planning to go.’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W08-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using modal verbs, including with complex tenses, for example in ‘They should not have to go.’ and ‘This needs to be considered.’

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W09 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: use relative clauses and adjectival expressions for descriptive purposes

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W09-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing relative clauses to add description, for example in ‘The group, which consisted of 4 men and 4 women …’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W09-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: writing complex adjectival phrases to describe concrete and abstract nouns in sentences, for example in ‘The most reliable and efficient product on the market …’ and ‘The convincing scientific evidence supporting this theory …’

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W10 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: use an expanded vocabulary appropriate for the curriculum area

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W10-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: incorporating sophisticated vocabulary appropriate for the curriculum area, including subject-specific terms, antonyms, synonyms and abstract nouns, into their own writing

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W10-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: distinguishing between meanings of words in different contexts, such as the meanings of ‘complex’ in ‘psychological complex’, ‘complex issue’, ‘complex sentence’ and ‘residential complex’

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W10-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using imagery appropriately in a range of texts; for example, including metaphors and similes in a narrative to create nuance, mood and feeling

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W10-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using some idioms or euphemisms learnt from reading and viewing diverse texts

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W11 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: spell words accurately using a range of strategies

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W11-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: spelling accurately a wide range of words including unusual and technical words, using knowledge of spelling conventions and patterns and of phoneme–grapheme correspondences

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W11-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: referring to dictionaries, online tools, curriculum area texts and a personal vocabulary list to check spelling

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W11-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using translation apps to check accuracy of spelling

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W12 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: use a wide range of formatting and features, including punctuation marks, to add impact to writing

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W12-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: producing texts in a range of digital formats (such as text documents, slides, infographics, simple websites and videos) with applicable punctuation

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W12-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using advanced writing and formatting functions in digital applications (such as a spellchecker, font styles and paragraph formatting) to vary punctuation and formatting features

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W12-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using digital tools to add, format and edit images and tables, with guidance

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W13 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: analyse and evaluate the ways in which different cultural contexts, audiences and purposes influence function and form

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W13-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: choosing from a range of text types to communicate a message clearly; for example, writing an analytical essay or creating a short slide show to explain an issue to the class

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W13-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: identifying the context, purpose and audience of a text when planning and drafting

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W13-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: choosing and sustaining appropriate language for an intended audience and purpose; for example, using a formal register for an academic audience

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W14 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: revise and edit texts independently

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W14-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: re-reading drafted text and using specific vocabulary, idioms or quotations translated from a home language to emphasise a point

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W14-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: revising text to include technical language specific to a text type and curriculum area, for example when writing a report on a chemistry experiment

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W14-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using advanced digital tools such as a spellchecker, font styles and paragraph formatting to improve writing

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W15 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: draw on an extensive and varied range of home language resources when writing

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W15-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: inferring the meaning and translation of unfamiliar words, based on context and previous learning in a home language

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W15-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: making their own translations of specific words and phrases

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W15-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using an accessible English and/or bilingual dictionary to check the meaning of unfamiliar words

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W15-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: crosschecking meaning in English and a home language to confirm accurate understanding of key concepts and vocabulary

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W15-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: contributing vocabulary found using dictionaries to classroom vocabulary lists

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W15-E06 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: referring to home language or bilingual texts such as glossaries, dictionaries and online translation tools for explanation and clarification of new vocabulary and information

substrand_content_descriptions.name: VC2EALC4W16 - EAL Pathway C
substrand_content_descriptions.text: contribute to and lead shared writing events

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W16-E01 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: managing group functions, explaining tasks and supporting peer participation using a home language as well as English

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W16-E02 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: using a home language as well as English to generate additional ideas in brainstorming activities

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W16-E03 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: seeking and giving feedback with peers on draft writing using a home language and English

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W16-E04 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: giving and interpreting feedback in different formats, for example by using coloured or highlighter pens on print texts, typing comments on digital texts and completing a feedback checklist

elaborations.name: VC2EALC4W16-E05 - EAL Pathway C
elaborations.elaboration_text: incorporating feedback on a range of aspects; for example, redrafting a personal recount to edit out unnecessary detail
